item.title: Ozark, Missouri timeshare salesman sentenced to prison for tax fraud
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — A judge has sentenced an Ozark, Missouri, timeshare salesman after attempting to evade taxation. According to a United States Department of Justice press release, Ryan J. McMillin, 52, was sentenced by U.S. District Judge M. item.title: Window to thaw out has ended, snowcover sticking around
item.description: Temperatures will remain below freezing until Sunday afternoon, with snow cover persisting through the weekend and a Cold Advisory in effect for Saturday morning, before a thaw resumes Monday and another system brings a threat of rain and wintry mix Tuesday.

item.title: Best debut album ever? Van Halen I album review
item.description: Ozarks First's Parker Padgett and Tony Nguyen dive into Van Halen's 1978 album "Van Halen", highlighting Eddie Van Halen's two-handed tapping, David Lee Roth's vocals, and its influence on the '80s hard rock movement.
